testcase.name: Scenario: Restore the full ribbon while a temporary panel is expanded: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:456:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Restore the full ribbon while a temporary panel is expanded ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the ribbon is minimized to tabs ✔ And the ribbon display policy is "Minimize to Tabs" ✔ And the 3D Model tab is selected ✔ When the user clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ Then its ribbon panels appear temporarily ✔ When the user opens the Modify panel's additional commands ✔ Then the additional commands appear below the temporary ribbon ✔ When the user clicks the ribbon display control to restore the full ribbon ✔ Then the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed ✔ And the additional commands are closed ✔ And the part remains visible
